gaps.sentence: He stayed ___ touch with every colleague he'd ever had.
Applications must be received ___ two weeks of the closing date.
gaps.explanation: 'Within two weeks' = not later than two weeks after.

gaps.sentence: The lifeguard pulled the swimmer ___ the water just in time.
gaps.explanation: 'Pull somebody from the water' = rescue them out of it.
'from 1 January' = beginning on that date (also 'with effect from').

gaps.sentence: The library stays open ___ to midnight during the exam period.
gaps.explanation: 'Up to midnight' = until as late as midnight.

gaps.sentence: She succeeded in ___ of repeated setbacks.
I'm afraid we're ___ of options at this point.
He acted on his own ___ and did not ask permission.
gaps.hint: on your own ___ = without being told
gaps.explanation: 'On one's own initiative' = deciding and acting independently.
